headline: Rwanda Promulgates New Central Bank Legal Framework
summary: Rwanda has published Law No. 033/2026 governing the National Bank of Rwanda, marking the latest milestone in the evolution of the country's central banking legislation.
why: Central bank legal reforms typically modernize regulatory powers, monetary policy mandates, and supervisory frameworks for commercial banking sectors in developing economies.

impacts.name: Rwanda
impacts.why: Updated central bank mandates strengthen institutional governance and financial system stability oversight.
